description.value: A waterfront maritime museum at Port Alberni's Harbour Quay, operated by the Port Alberni Maritime Heritage Society since 1989. Exhibits cover West Coast shipwrecks, navigation history, the restored Bamfield Lifeboat, ship models spanning centuries of local maritime activity, and the 1964 tsunami. Situated near restaurants and shops at the quay, it makes a natural stop for cyclists riding through the Alberni Valley.

address.value: 2900 Harbour Rd, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 7X2
